name: fortiedrCommandTimeline
title: FortiEDR Command Timeline
subTitle: The process/cmd timeline behind a FortiEDR alert, rendered from the timeline stored in the alert's sourcedata.
releaseNotes: Initial release: renders the command timeline the fortinet-fortiedrv2 connector (1.1.12+) stores on an alert's sourcedata when its Include Command Timeline flag is on -- the chronological process/cmd stages behind the detection, with command lines, PIDs, certificate status and module frames.

metadata.description: Renders the process/cmd command timeline stored on a FortiEDR alert's sourcedata (command_timeline, written by the fortinet-fortiedrv2 connector's Include Command Timeline flag). Shows the event header (host, OS, destination, first/last seen) above a chronological rail of process stages: stage name, process path and PID, the command line, certificate status, and the module frames each stage loaded. Alerts ingested without the flag show how to enable it.
